heading: Roles
description: What people at this hospital are allowed to do depends on their role. Built-in roles cannot be renamed or deleted; add your own for anything else.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: A new role holds no permissions until you give it some.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The role is removed from this hospital. This cannot be undone.

errors.exists: A role with that name already exists.
errors.builtIn: Built-in roles cannot be renamed or deleted.
errors.inUse: People or open invitations still use this role. Move them to another role first.
errors.notAllowed: You cannot change a role that may do more than yours.

matrix.heading: Permissions of {{name}}
matrix.description: Choose what people in this role may do. A change reaches open sessions within minutes.

reason.notHeld: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot give it.
reason.ownAccess: You cannot take away your own ability to manage roles.

matrix.viewOnly: You can see what this role may do but not change it.
matrix.above: This role may do more than yours does, so only someone with at least its access can change it.
matrix.ownRole: This is your own role. You cannot remove role management from it.
matrix.conflict_one: Someone else changed this role while you were editing. Your changes are kept; {{count}} permission you changed was also changed, shown beside it. Review, then save again.
matrix.conflict_other: Someone else changed this role while you were editing. Your changes are kept; {{count}} permissions you changed were also changed, shown beside them. Review, then save again.
matrix.errorTitle: The role could not be loaded

errors.lastAdmin: Nobody would be left to manage roles or staff. Keep these permissions in a role that people hold.
errors.ownAccess: You cannot take away your own ability to manage roles.
errors.unknown: A permission in the list is not known to the system. Reload the page.

preview.heading: View as {{name}}
preview.description: The menu, pages and actions a person in this role would get, worked out the way the app does for them. This is only a preview: nothing is saved and your own access does not change.
